answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network applies a graph-based auditing mechanism where an agent stake is bonded before signing audits with an immutable cryptographic quill. Game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces stake slashing against colluders, while topological cut verifications act like a prism to decompose cluster density. Because Sybils cannot fake sparse boundary cuts, attacker cost scales at a superlinear rate against willow networks.
